detail.body:
## Summary

Reduce Mamba2 speculative-decoding memory by replacing full candidate-state
snapshots with compact input records. FlashInfer reconstructs only the accepted
live/tracking states, leaving more memory for reusable checkpoints and active requests.
Enable with `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec`.

## Implementation

- Native FlashInfer `checkpointing_ssu` verifies candidates without modifying
  live state; `replayssm_materialize` eagerly commits accepted endpoints.
- Preserve convolution rollback, complete persistent checkpoints, and exact
  copies when tracking and live endpoints coincide.
- Include compact records and supporting buffers in pool sizing.

Code: [verify/commit adapter](https://github.com/NVShreyas/sglang/blob/8c4c8ce5a15e62817fd8838c08f93100ec078e42/python/sglang/kernels/ops/mamba/mamba2_spec_replay.py),
[configuration checks](https://github.com/NVShreyas/sglang/blob/8c4c8ce5a15e62817fd8838c08f93100ec078e42/python/sglang/srt/configs/mamba2_spec_replay.py).

Supported initially: SM100, main's pinned FlashInfer 0.7.1, BF16 activations/FP16 state,
head/state dimensions 64/128, EAGLE/NEXTN top-k 1 with four verification positions;
stochastic rounding supported. Unified/page-major pools, adaptive/ragged
verification, int8 checkpoints and combining with `--enable-linear-replayssm`
and PD disaggregation are unsupported. Deferred replay is not enabled.

## AgentX results

Public model: [NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B NVFP4](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4),
revision `ff433f5493e25d631c9f12b5d55c674229923d02`; one B200, TP1.
Both variants use Triton recurrent prefill, FP8 KV, FP16 recurrent state,
EAGLE three steps/four positions and **synthetic AL3.2527** (`match-expected`,
fixed-token mode). No offloading or unified pools.

### Public trace and replay settings

- AIPerf AgentX MVP, pinned dataset
  [`semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k`](https://huggingface.co/datasets/semianalysisai/cc-traces-weka-062126-256k),
  alias `semianalysis_cc_traces_weka_062126_256k`; all eligible sessions, seed42.
- **900 measured seconds per point**, one run; C16/C32/C64 count concurrent
  **session trees**, including subagent fan-out—not in-flight requests.
- Preserve recorded inter-turn delays, trajectory-start ratios0–1 and global
  idle-gap cap10s. AgentX trajectory warmup seeds measurement; flush cache before
  each point and use `first_turn_prefix` cache-busting. No extra session cap.
- Same instrumented SGLang base (main `41cbe65de0`) and full upstream FlashInfer
  `461037fbf` (`0.7.2+g461037fbf`) for both sides. “Stock” means the default
  snapshot path on that build, not pristine/latest main. These historical
  performance runs predate the current rebase and shared-flag cleanup; they are
  not a fresh throughput measurement of the current PR head.
- Shared serving settings: context1,048,576; prefill/chunk32768; page64;
  `extra_buffer`, tracking128; stochastic rounding/Philox5; memory fraction0.85;
  max-running256; graph cap256; `trtllm_mha`. AIPerf commit
  `754356e9a39acc6cc6afb242d123bb57c3fb6f75`.

| Session trees | Stock output tok/s | Replay output tok/s | Gain |
| ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| 16 | 340.09 | 358.63 | +5.4% |
| 32 | 859.83 | 906.82 | +5.5% |
| 64 | 840.75 | 1,216.77 | **+44.7%** |

At C64, jointly usable prefix reuse rises **81.98% → 89.08%**, while the share
of raw Full-KV hits trimmed for recurrent compatibility falls **12.80% → 5.71%**.
Cache counters cover profiling plus drain, with <1s scrape-boundary uncertainty.
These are replay-only gains; SSD's additional benefit is reported in #42650.

All six points passed AgentX's `submission_valid` check. C16/C32 had no client
errors; C64 had one per variant (stock: connection reset; replay: empty-content
response), with 940/1249 successful requests. Both C64 runs reached the40s drain
timeout; error/cancellation attribution remains pending. The validity flag is
not a zero-error or accuracy certificate. Client ITL was zero, so no TPOT claim
is made here. Single runs, no confidence intervals; faster variants traverse
more turns, and configured synthetic AL does not guarantee identical realized AL.

## Full GSM8K accuracy

Public model/revision above; one B200, TP1, **all 1,319 test questions**, C64,
one repeat, temperature0, top_p1, seed42, thinking enabled, output cap32,768.
**Real speculative acceptance: all synthetic-acceptance environment variables
were removed.** No SSD prefill, offloading, unified pools, or experiment overlays.

| | Stock snapshot path | replaySSM |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Correct / evaluated | 1,269 / 1,319 | 1,265 / 1,319 |
| Accuracy | **96.21%** | **95.91%** |
| Request errors | 0 | 0 |
| Truncated responses (included in score) | 2 | 1 |
| Evaluation time | 363.13 s | 321.59 s |

Replay is **0.30 percentage points lower (four fewer correct)** in this pair.
One run per variant does not establish equivalence or a repeatable regression.
Output lengths differ; these elapsed times are not a controlled throughput claim.

Accuracy ran on the clean public PR tree at
[082daa0bcb](https://github.com/NVShreyas/sglang/commit/082daa0bcba6b480108e3ed930c4ad9c9d1444e7),
based on main e9400c5a8f, before the subsequent review cleanup.
Environment: PyTorch2.14.1+cu130, FlashInfer0.7.1, sglang-kernel0.4.9,
Transformers5.19.0, sgl-eval0.1.2.

<details>
<summary>Server and GSM8K reproduction commands</summary>

Paths and ports below are normalized. MODEL_PATH is a local snapshot of
nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4 at revision
ff433f5493e25d631c9f12b5d55c674229923d02.
Start a fresh server for each variant. The only serving difference is the replay flag.

~~~bash
export MODEL_PATH=/path/to/model-snapshot
export PUBLIC_MODEL=nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B-NVFP4
export PORT=30000
export SGLANG_ALLOW_OVERWRITE_LONGER_CONTEXT_LEN=1
while IFS= read -r name; do
  unset "$name"
done < <(compgen -e | grep '^SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_' || true)

# Shared server arguments, also used for the historical AgentX comparison below.
server_args=(
  --model-path "$MODEL_PATH" --served-model-name "$PUBLIC_MODEL"
  --speculative-draft-model-path "$MODEL_PATH" --trust-remote-code --tp 1
  --context-length 1048576 --max-prefill-tokens 32768 --chunked-prefill-size 32768
  --page-size 64 --mamba-backend flashinfer --mamba-ssm-dtype float16
  --enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding --mamba-cache-philox-rounds 5
  --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer --mamba-track-interval 128
  --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --max-running-requests 256
  --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode 256 --speculative-algorithm EAGLE
  --speculative-num-steps 3 --speculative-eagle-topk 1 --speculative-num-draft-tokens 4
  --attention-backend trtllm_mha --reasoning-parser nemotron_3
  --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --enable-metrics
  --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"
)
replay_args=()                                # stock
# replay_args=(--enable-linear-replayssm-spec) # replay variant
python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${server_args[@]}" --random-seed 42 "${replay_args[@]}"
~~~

From another shell after readiness, with the same PUBLIC_MODEL/PORT; choose a
separate output directory for each variant:

~~~bash
curl --fail -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/flush_cache"
sgl-eval run gsm8k \
  --base-url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/v1" --model "$PUBLIC_MODEL" \
  --num-examples 1319 --num-threads 64 --n-repeats 1 \
  --temperature 0 --top-p 1 --seed 42 --max-tokens 32768 \
  --chat-template-kwarg enable_thinking=true --out-dir ./gsm8k-results
~~~

</details>

<details>
<summary>Historical AgentX server/client commands</summary>

Use the historical environment and AIPerf commit documented above. That runtime
used the earlier --enable-mamba2-spec-replay flag spelling; on the current PR
use --enable-linear-replayssm-spec. Reuse the shared server_args array above
(without GSM8K's additional random-seed argument). Recurrent prefill used the
default Triton path on that runtime:

~~~bash
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_LEN=3.2527
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_METHOD=match-expected
export SGLANG_SIMULATE_ACC_TOKEN_MODE=fixed
replay_args=()                            # stock
# replay_args=(--enable-mamba2-spec-replay) # historical replay runtime only
python3 -m sglang.launch_server "${server_args[@]}" \
  --uvicorn-access-log-exclude-prefixes /metrics /health /health_generate \
  "${replay_args[@]}"
~~~

After readiness, run the following separately for each server variant, in
separate output directories. The scenario and options are documented in the
[pinned public AIPerf AgentX guide](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/aiperf/blob/754356e9a39acc6cc6afb242d123bb57c3fb6f75/docs/tutorials/agentx-mvp.md).

export AIPERF_DATASET_CONFIGURATION_TIMEOUT=1800

  aiperf profile --scenario inferencex-agentx-mvp \
    --url "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT" \

    --use-server-token-count --streaming --extra-inputs ignore_eos:true \
    --cache-bust first_turn_prefix --system-idle-gap-cap-seconds 10 \
    --trajectory-start-min-ratio 0.0 --trajectory-start-max-ratio 1.0 \
    --server-metrics "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/metrics" \
    --slice-duration 1.0 --no-gpu-telemetry \
    --output-artifact-dir "./agentx-c$concurrency" --ui simple

~~~

## Validation and remaining work

- Earlier B200 kernel/integration/sizing validation covered accepted endpoints,
  tracking, slot reuse, CUDA graphs, stochastic rounding and allocation accounting.
- Full GSM8K off/on results above exercise the rebased public tree with real
  speculative acceptance, separately from synthetic-acceptance performance runs.
- Subsequent review cleanup: all six CPU sizing/dispatch tests and three
  kernel-test import/help entrypoint checks pass with FlashInfer0.7.1.
  Standard pre-commit and CI registration checks pass.
- Removed the exact-version guard, pipeline benchmark, diagnostic bypass,
  custom test CLI modes, and obsolete CLI-history test. Kernel implementations,
  all seven FlashInfer contract/materialization cases, and tolerances are unchanged.
- GPU tests/GSM8K have not been rerun after the final cleanup.
  Public-tree CI on the new head remains to be checked.

+"""Eager accepted-state commits using FlashInfer 0.7's native ring materializer.
+
+Ring history is transient, with start=pending=0 at every verification entry.
+Tracking endpoints must be written before the accepted live state overwrites
+their common source. Live slots are unique; tracking destinations are distinct
+from every live slot, as guaranteed by the request/state allocator.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+
+def make_replay_pointer_table(state, x, B, dt, A):
+    """Build persistent tables at pool construction, never inside graph capture.
+
+    Return [layers, 11] with contiguous *columns*: the State layer-view convention
+    uses axis zero, while FlashInfer consumes each whole-layer column separately.
+    """
+    tables = []
+    for tensor in (state, x, B, dt):
+        tables.extend(
+            ([layer.data_ptr() for layer in tensor], [tensor.stride(1)] * len(tensor))
+        )
+    tables.extend(([layer.data_ptr() for layer in A], [0] * len(A), [0] * len(A)))
+    return torch.tensor(tables, dtype=torch.int64, device=state.device).T
+
+
+def materialize_flashinfer_mamba2(
+    state,
+    x,
+    B,
+    dt,
+    A,
+    pointer_table,
+    slots,
+    last,
+    tracks=None,
+    track_steps=None,
+    *,
+    seed=None,
+    philox_rounds=0,
+):
+    """Commit zero-based accepted/tracking endpoints, masking padded requests.
+
+    All metadata transforms are device operations (also CUDA-graph capturable).
+    No host reads of acceptance lengths and no full-state staging allocation.
+    The native kernel supports identical source/destination slots for a live
+    commit; no two physical request rows may write/read the same live slot.
+    """
+    from flashinfer.mamba import replayssm_materialize
+
+    if slots.numel() == 0:
+        return
+    layers, capacity, heads, dim, dstate = state.shape
+    ring_len = x.shape[3]
+    width = ring_len // 2
+    assert pointer_table.shape == (layers, 11)
+    assert (tracks is None) == (track_steps is None)
+    valid = (slots >= 0) & (slots < capacity) & (last >= 0) & (last < width)
+    src = torch.where(valid, slots, -1).to(torch.int32).repeat(layers, 1)
+    start = torch.zeros(slots.numel(), dtype=torch.int32, device=slots.device)
+    active = torch.arange(slots.numel(), dtype=torch.int32, device=slots.device)
+
+    def materialize(dst, lengths):
+        replayssm_materialize(
+            *pointer_table.unbind(dim=1),
+            src,
+            dst,
+            start,
+            lengths,
+            active,
+            state_dtype=state.dtype,
+            input_dtype=x.dtype,
+            matrixA_dtype=A.dtype,
+            dim=dim,
+            dstate=dstate,
+            num_heads=heads,
+            heads_per_group=heads // B.shape[2],
+            max_window=width,
+            ring_buffer_len=ring_len,
+            rand_seed=seed,
+            philox_rounds=philox_rounds,
+            dependency_inputs=[x, B, dt, A],
+            dependency_outputs=[state],
+        )
+
+    if tracks is not None:
+        track_valid = (
+            valid
+            & (tracks >= 0)
+            & (tracks < capacity)
+            & (track_steps >= 0)
+            & (track_steps <= last)
+        )
+        dst = torch.where(track_valid, tracks, -1).to(torch.int32).repeat(layers, 1)
+        lengths = torch.where(track_valid, track_steps + 1, 0).to(torch.int32)
+        materialize(dst, lengths)
+    lengths = torch.where(valid, last + 1, 0).to(torch.int32)
+    materialize(src, lengths)
+    if tracks is not None:
+        # SR uses destination-address-based counters. When endpoints coincide,
+        # copy the accepted state exactly instead of retaining an independently
+        # rounded tracking state. Other tracking endpoints keep the old-base
+        # result produced before the in-place live commit.
+        same_endpoint = track_valid & (track_steps == last)
+        dst = torch.where(same_endpoint, tracks, -1).to(torch.int32).repeat(layers, 1)
+        materialize(dst, torch.zeros_like(lengths))

+"""FlashInfer checkpointing verify with eager accepted-state commit.
+
+Records are physical-slot indexed. Pending history stays zero: verification
+never changes live state, and the accepted endpoint is materialized before the
+next forward. Compact records are scratch, not transferable radix checkpoints.
+"""
+
+from functools import lru_cache
+
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_exec
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def checkpointing_kernel():
+    from flashinfer.mamba import checkpointing_ssu
+
+    return checkpointing_ssu
+
+
+def verify_mamba2_replay(
+    state,
+    x,
+    dt,
+    A,
+    B,
+    C,
+    D=None,
+    *,
+    layer_cache,
+    z=None,
+    dt_bias=None,
+    dt_softplus=False,
+    state_batch_indices=None,
+    pad_slot_id=-1,
+    out=None,
+    disable_state_update=False,
+    intermediate_states_buffer=None,
+    cache_steps=None,
+    retrieve_parent_token=None,
+    intermediate_state_indices=None,
+):
+    """SSU-compatible verify entry; writes records, never candidate snapshots."""
+    assert disable_state_update and intermediate_states_buffer is None
+    assert retrieve_parent_token is None
+    assert x.shape[1] == cache_steps == 4
+    assert layer_cache.intermediate_ssm is None
+    # The native materializer needs per-head A, which the old cumulative-decay
+    # record encoded implicitly. Copy into graph-stable pool-owned storage.
+    layer_cache.mamba2_replay_A.copy_(A[:, 0, 0])
+    checkpointing_kernel()(
+        state=state,
+        x_cache=layer_cache.mamba2_replay_x,
+        B_cache=layer_cache.mamba2_replay_B,
+        dt_cache=layer_cache.mamba2_replay_dt,
+        ring_start=layer_cache.mamba2_replay_ring_start,
+        prev_num_accepted_tokens=layer_cache.mamba2_replay_pending,
+        x=x,
+        dt=dt,
+        A=A,
+        B=B,
+        C=C,
+        D=D,
+        z=z,
+        out=out,
+        dt_bias=dt_bias,
+        dt_softplus=dt_softplus,
+        state_batch_indices=state_batch_indices,
+        pad_slot_id=pad_slot_id,
+        # p=0 and ring_len=2*T prevent checkpoint writes. SR is only needed
+        # when acceptance materializes a state, not for verification outputs.
+        algorithm="monolith",
+    )
+
+
+def commit_mamba2_replay(cache, slots, last, tracks=None, track_steps=None):
+    """Materialize all-layer endpoints; convolution rollback remains unchanged."""

+        seed = cache.mamba2_replay_seed[:1]

+        cache.temporal,
+        cache.mamba2_replay_x,
+        cache.mamba2_replay_B,
+        cache.mamba2_replay_dt,
+        cache.mamba2_replay_A,
+        cache.mamba2_replay_ptrs,

+
+No model or server is loaded. JSON measurements distinguish numerical error
+from exact state/buffer lifetime invariants. Run directly with Python on CUDA.
+"""

+import json
+import unittest

+from flashinfer.mamba import checkpointing_ssu, selective_state_update

+def error_summary(actual, expected):
+    a, b = actual.float(), expected.float()
+    delta = a - b
+    scale = b.square().mean().sqrt().clamp_min(1e-20)
+    worst = delta.abs().reshape(-1).argmax()
+    eps = torch.finfo(torch.bfloat16).eps
+    return {
+        "rms_relative": (delta.square().mean().sqrt() / scale).item(),
+        "max_relative_to_rms": (delta.abs().max() / scale).item(),
+        "max_absolute": delta.abs().max().item(),
+        "finite": bool(torch.isfinite(a).all()),
+        "worst_reference": b.reshape(-1)[worst].item(),
+        "worst_actual": a.reshape(-1)[worst].item(),
+        "max_bf16_scaled_error": (delta.abs() / (eps * (b.abs() + scale))).max().item(),
+    }
+
+
+def check_numerics(label, actual, expected, **metadata):
+    stats = error_summary(actual, expected)
+    print(json.dumps({"comparison": label, **metadata, **stats}), flush=True)
+    # Tensor-core BF16 arithmetic is not bitwise equal to the scalar recurrence.
+    # RMS <= one BF16 epsilon. Peak error uses four BF16 eps times
+    # (abs(reference) + RMS), accounting for scaled-B/output rounding and
+    # cancellation. The original magnitude-independent peak screen rejected
+    # a 0.125 difference on a -44.4375 value; preserve it in the JSON report.
+    # This is a kernel screening ceiling, not a model-accuracy qualification.
+    eps = torch.finfo(torch.bfloat16).eps
+    assert stats["finite"], label
+    assert stats["rms_relative"] <= eps, (label, stats)
+    assert stats["max_bf16_scaled_error"] <= 4, (label, stats)
+
+
+class FlashInferCase:
+    def __init__(self, batch=5, width=4, window=None, rounding=False):
+        self.batch, self.width = batch, width
+        self.pointer_table = None
+        self.window = window or width
+        self.h, self.p, self.g, self.n = 128, 64, 8, 128
+        h, p, g, n = self.h, self.p, self.g, self.n
+        self.capacity = 2 * batch + 3
+        k, w = self.capacity, self.window
+        dtype, device = torch.bfloat16, "cuda"
+        self.initial = torch.randn(k, h, p, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float16)
+        self.state = self.initial.clone()
+        self.reference = self.initial.clone()
+        self.slots = torch.arange(batch, device=device, dtype=torch.int32) * 2 + 1
+        self.rows = torch.arange(batch, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        self.ring_start = torch.zeros(k, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        self.pending = torch.zeros_like(self.ring_start)
+        self.old_x = torch.zeros(k, h, w + width, p, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.old_B = torch.zeros(k, g, w + width, n, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.old_dt = torch.zeros(k, h, w + width, device=device)
+        self.A_base = -torch.rand(h, device=device) - 0.5
+        self.A = self.A_base[:, None, None].expand(h, p, n)
+        self.bias_base = torch.randn(h, device=device, dtype=dtype) - 2
+        self.bias = self.bias_base[:, None].expand(h, p)
+        self.D = torch.randn(h, device=device, dtype=dtype)[:, None].expand(h, p)
+        self.seed = (
+            torch.tensor([81723], device=device, dtype=torch.int64)
+            if rounding
+            else None
+        )
+        self.snapshots = torch.empty(
+            batch, width, h, p, n, device=device, dtype=torch.float16
+        )
+        self.out = torch.empty(batch, width, h, p, device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        self.ref_out = torch.empty_like(self.out)
+        # Noncontiguous inputs like the mixer projection/split views.
+        self.packed = torch.empty(
+            batch, width, h * p + 2 * g * n + h, device=device, dtype=dtype
+        )
+        self.x = self.packed[..., : h * p].view(batch, width, h, p)
+        self.B = self.packed[..., h * p : h * p + g * n].view(batch, width, g, n)
+        self.C = self.packed[..., h * p + g * n : h * p + 2 * g * n].view(
+            batch, width, g, n
+        )
+        self.raw_dt = self.packed[..., -h:]
+        self.dt = self.raw_dt[..., None].expand(batch, width, h, p)
+        self.randomize()
+
+    def randomize(self):
+        self.packed.normal_()
+
+    def verify(self, replay):
+        shared = dict(
+            x=self.x,
+            dt=self.dt,
+            A=self.A,
+            B=self.B,
+            C=self.C,
+            D=self.D,
+            dt_bias=self.bias,

+                self.state,
+                self.old_x,
+                self.old_B,
+                self.old_dt,
+                self.ring_start,
+                self.pending,
+                out=self.out,
+                algorithm="monolith",
+                **shared,
+            )
+        else:
+            selective_state_update(
+                self.reference,
+                out=self.ref_out,
+                disable_state_update=True,
+                intermediate_states_buffer=self.snapshots,
+                intermediate_state_indices=self.rows,
+                cache_steps=self.width,
+                **shared,
+            )
+

+        slots = self.slots[valid].long()

+            self.x[valid].transpose(1, 2),

+            atol=0,
+        )

+            self.old_B[slots, :, : self.width],
+            self.B[valid].transpose(1, 2),
+            rtol=0,
+            atol=0,
+        )
+        dt = torch.nn.functional.softplus(
+            self.raw_dt[valid].float() + self.bias_base.float()
+        )
+        # CUDA's fast log/exp softplus is not PyTorch's log1p path.
+        # Charge four FP32 eps; keep copied x/B byte-exact.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            self.old_dt[slots, :, : self.width],
+            dt.transpose(1, 2),
+            rtol=2e-6,
+            atol=4 * torch.finfo(torch.float32).eps,
+        )
+

+            c.check_records()

+    @torch.inference_mode()

+
